scope: Typed operational quantities and prices only. Raw/source accounting amounts, credit-note values, balances and round-off remain signed. Nullable parsed fields remain unknown until reviewed; no zero default or data backfill.

crossFieldChecks.note: Only enforced when all three facts are known; incomplete extraction remains NULL.

nullableReviewFields: Unreviewed supplier replies, acceptances, source invoices and source schedules may omit parsed quantities/rates. Their typed values stay NULL, not zero. Required row/parent identities remain NOT NULL. Confirmation/activation endpoints must reject missing fields in their stage-specific workflows.

signedExceptions.customer_po_lines.source_rate: Unmodified original source rate retained for mismatch review; normalized unit_price is separately nonnegative.
signedExceptions.customer_po_lines.source_line_total: Unmodified original line amount retained for review, including credits or malformed source evidence.
signedExceptions.supplier_acceptances.source_total: Original supplier total is evidence, not a normalized approval amount.
signedExceptions.supplier_acceptances.round_off: Round-off may be positive or negative.
signedExceptions.bank_statement_lines.balance: Bank account balance may be negative.
signedExceptions.stock_check_log.free_quantity: Calculated shortage/free-stock result may be negative; clamp only at the workflow display boundary if explicitly required.
signedExceptions.invoice_lines.quantity: Tally/source invoice line evidence may represent returns or credits; invoice authority is not inferred.
signedExceptions.invoice_lines.unit_price: Original source credit/invoice evidence must preserve its sign.
signedExceptions.invoice_lines.supplied_line_total: Original source amount may include credit or reversal entries.
signedExceptions.invoice_lines.calculated_line_total: Recalculated amount preserves source line sign for reconciliation.
